title: Convex ordering for graphon mean-field systems
summary: We establish marginal and functional convex order comparisons for graphon mean-field systems on $\mathbb{R}^d$, including the infinite-horizon setting. A key difficulty is that convex order cannot in general be transferred through the usual particle approximation, which requires us to work directly with Euler schemes for the graphon mean-field system. Under a suitable dissipativity condition, we establish Euler approximation estimates that are uniform in both time and the agent label, and combine them with forward-backward induction arguments to obtain the convex order comparisons.
